main.summary: Manifest describing an append or follow stream-transfer session.

field.name: ManifestFileName
field.summary: Conventional file name for the persisted manifest JSON document.

field.name: ObjectFileName
field.summary: Conventional file name for the persisted refined object payload.

field.name: StreamFileName
field.summary: Conventional file name for the durable appended stream payload.

property.name: AppendedLength
property.summary: Current durable appended length in bytes.

property.name: ObjectPayload
property.summary: Optional serialized object payload used for stream-transfer publication or refinement.

property.name: ObjectSHA512
property.summary: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload when present.

property.name: SourceSessionID
property.summary: Optional source session identifier for follower sessions.

property.name: StreamSHA512
property.summary: Optional final SHA-512 of the durable stream payload.

method.name: CanReadRange
method.summary: Determine whether a follower read range is currently available within the durable appended prefix.
method.returns: True when the range is currently readable.

method.name: CanWriteRange
method.summary: Determine whether a source append range begins exactly at the current durable appended length.
method.returns: True when the range satisfies exact-tail append semantics.

method.name: Deserialize
method.summary: Parse a manifest from UTF-8 JSON bytes.
method.returns: Parsed manifest when successful; otherwise null.

method.name: GetRealizedBytes
method.summary: Return the current durable appended byte count.

method.name: Load
method.summary: Load a manifest from a file path.
method.returns: Loaded manifest when successful; otherwise null.

method.name: Parse
method.summary: Parse a manifest from JSON text.
method.returns: Parsed manifest when successful; otherwise null.

method.name: Save
method.summary: Persist the manifest to a file path.
method.returns: True when the manifest was written successfully.

method.name: Serialize
method.summary: Serialize the manifest to UTF-8 JSON bytes.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Serialize the manifest to JSON text.

method.name: ToState
method.summary: Materialize a stream-transfer state view from the manifest.

method.name: Touch
method.summary: Return a manifest with updated timestamp and incremented state version.
method.param: True to clear any fault message.

method.name: TryParse
method.summary: Attempt to parse a manifest from JSON text.

method.name: Validate
method.summary: Determine whether the manifest content is internally valid.
method.returns: True when the manifest is valid.

method.name: ValidateHash
method.summary: Determine whether a SHA-512 hash buffer has the expected length.
method.returns: True when the buffer length matches SHA-512 output.

method.name: ValidateOptionalHash
method.summary: Determine whether an optional hash buffer is omitted or has the expected SHA-512 length.
method.returns: True when the buffer is omitted or valid.

method.name: WithAppendedLength
method.summary: Return a manifest with an updated durable appended length, timestamp, and incremented state version.

method.name: WithStatus
method.summary: Return a manifest with an updated status, fault message, timestamp, and incremented state version.
